facts.en: Awarded a performing-arts administration diploma by Fictional Twilightsail College in 2019.
facts.zh: 2019 年获虚构暮帆学院颁发演艺行政文凭。

facts.en: Paid permissions records assistant at Fictional Velvet Lantern Theatre from 2020-09 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2020-09 至 2026-08 在虚构绒灯剧院任有薪许可记录助理。

facts.en: Logged permission requests for scripted performances and attached the relevant correspondence.
facts.zh: 记录剧本演出的许可申请，并附上相关往来函件。

facts.en: Recorded the territory, performance dates and permitted number of shows exactly as stated in signed permissions.
facts.zh: 按已签署许可原文记录适用地区、演出日期及获准场次。

facts.en: Kept unsigned requests marked as pending rather than filing them as executed permissions.
facts.zh: 将未签署申请标为待处理，而非归档为已签立许可。

facts.en: Sent reminder emails before recorded permission expiry dates using the producer’s approved template.
facts.zh: 使用制作人批准的模板，在已记录许可到期日前发送提醒邮件。

facts.en: Flagged planned performances outside the recorded dates to the producer for review.
facts.zh: 将计划中超出已记录日期范围的演出标记给制作人审核。

facts.en: Rebuilt the permissions register’s status fields in 2024-06 with the production administrator.
facts.zh: 2024-06 与制作行政专员共同重建许可登记表的状态字段。

facts.en: Personally migrated request dates and signature-status flags; the administrator checked contract-scope entries.
facts.zh: 个人迁移申请日期及签署状态标记；合同范围条目由行政专员核对。

facts.en: A 2024-07 reconciliation matched 31 of 33 sampled register entries to the corresponding permission document.
facts.zh: 2024-07 核对中，33 条抽样登记记录有 31 条与相应许可文件匹配。

facts.en: The 2 unmatched entries remained on an exception list at that check; the source does not record their later resolution.
facts.zh: 该次检查时，2 条未匹配记录仍在异常清单上；来源未记录其后续解决情况。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet filters, linked document indexes and calendar reminders.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格筛选、关联文档索引及日历提醒。

facts.en: Prepared a weekly list of outstanding requests and approaching expiries for the producer.
facts.zh: 每周为制作人准备未决申请及即将到期事项清单。

facts.en: The producer and external adviser negotiated terms; the candidate recorded the agreed wording after approval.
facts.zh: 条款由制作人与外部顾问协商；候选人在批准后记录议定措辞。

facts.en: Completed a short internal records-retention briefing in 2021; it was not a legal qualification.
facts.zh: 2021 年完成短期内部记录保存说明培训；该培训不是法律资格。

facts.en: Created a personal cue-sheet archive for invented puppet plays in 2025, without obtaining or granting any commercial rights.
facts.zh: 2025 年为虚构木偶剧制作个人提示单归档，未取得或授予任何商业权利。

facts.en: Volunteered to organize costumes at Fictional Poppy Curtain Club from 2018-10 to 2019-03.
facts.zh: 2018-10 至 2019-03 在虚构罂粟帘戏剧社志愿整理服装。

facts.en: Enjoys painting miniature stage backdrops.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制微型舞台背景。

facts.en: Restricted the permissions folder to the producer-approved access list.
facts.zh: 按照制作人批准的访问名单限制许可文件夹的访问。

facts.en: No authority to grant rights, sign permissions on behalf of rights holders or provide legal opinions is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录授予权利、代表权利人签署许可或出具法律意见的权限。
